headline: Strategic Bases Trade Hands Across Fronts
war_summary: Since the 0900 edition the tempo of base exchanges has risen sharply. Weathered Expanse now logs fifty‑three ownership changes in the last twenty‑four hours, with Colonial and Warden casualties both climbing and accelerating. Nevish Line records thirty‑three flips and casualty rates exceeding six hundred per hour for each side, also accelerating, while enlistments surge. Linn Mercy, previously cooling, shows thirty‑five flips and rapidly rising losses for both factions. Marban Hollow maintains a high turnover near thirty events, with Warden casualties accelerating. Mooring County, quiet in the last dispatch, has produced twenty‑four flips and rising casualty counts. Stlican Shelf adds seven flips and modestly accelerating enlistments. Kuura Strand and Stonecradle each see only a handful of changes. Meanwhile Callahans Passage and Dead Lands continue to bleed heavily with no base movement, and the majority of rear‑area hexes remain static.
